facts.fact: Benjamin Heavy Runner 登上 Christian 驾驶的 Sundancer 房车接管残局，盘算再撑一千二百英里、约十八小时赶到 Browning。
facts.anchor: No, better he climb aboard, keep this boat afloat for another, what, twelve hundred miles? Another eighteen hours to Browning, if they pushed?

facts.fact: Mooch Lomas 像鸟一样蹲守在卡座桌上，右手握着一把冰凿，并冲驾驶座喊「Go back, go back, he neeeeeds me!」，不肯丢下那个穿一身白的疯子（金头盔宇航员）。
facts.anchor: It was, of course, Mooch Lomas. She was perched like a damn bird up on the table of the little booth, her hands slapped out to each side to hold on, keep her there, her long hair cloaking her legs and body, an ice pick coming up through those grey strands, evidently gripped in her right hand.

facts.fact: Mooch 称她的儿子们附在人身上：Shell 附在司机 Christian 身里；Seine 将成为她的「中间那个」；最年幼的儿子被留在后面但会追来（Benjamin 立刻明白指金头盔「宇航员」），她还挥着一部小翻盖手机说「He already called me once」。
facts.anchor: “Shell’s in him,” Mooch said like it was obvious, pointing with her lips to Christian, watching them in the rearview. “This”—Seine—“is going to be my middle one, I’m pretty sure. He was always sneaky. And you left my youngest back there. But he’s coming, don’t you worry. He already called me once.” She waggled a little flip phone like him seeing that proved some call had really come in.

facts.fact: Benjamin 的表亲 Seine 发疯般从睡架上扑下袭击，Benjamin 扑上去把她顶进两个前座之间，拧下手边第一样东西侧握猛砸她左太阳穴将她砸晕——那正是 Christian 的后视镜，Christian 随后把后视镜要回去抱在怀里流泪。
facts.anchor: he reached up, wrenched off the first thing his hand could clamp on, and, holding it sideways, popped her fast and hard on the left temple.

facts.fact: Mooch 把超级胶抹上 Seine 的左手掌并把它紧按在车顶天花板上，倒数十秒；随后又给 Seine 的双脚脚背涂胶，把她整个人粘在天花板上。
facts.anchor: Mooch was already standing back up on the booth to smear the eye-stinging glue over Seine’s left palm and the undersides of her fingers. Then she pressed that palm hard to the ceiling, holding the packaging in her other hand, reading aloud: “Ten seconds, nine seconds, eight seconds…”

facts.fact: Seine 腹部皮下顶出一只有旧式拉环的啤酒罐——那种 Benjamin 十六岁时代的罐子；那正是当年二十八九岁、光彩照人的 Seine 在他初次上保留地、还没高中毕业时递给他的半罐，是他记得的八罐中的第一罐。
facts.anchor: It was the half-finished can Seine, in her late twenties and impossibly glamorous, so wild and Indian, a Blackfeet Sacajawea practically, had held out to him his first time up on the reservation, when he was barely a high schooler. That can was the first of eight he remembered, more he didn’t, the good-timers Seine was partying with having fun with seeing how much beer this kid from Denver could hold before it frothed back up.

facts.fact: Benjamin 的研究起点：一份 1898 年前后出自 Rosebud 的错编录音，记着约二十年前途经 Pine Ridge 的一次捉孩远征，里面含混提到一个 Heavy Runner；Richard Henry Pratt 烧毁卡片、档案与入学文件，掩盖 Carlisle 开办首年十一名男孩的死亡。
facts.anchor: When Benjamin had found that miscatalogued recording out of Rosebud circa 1898, detailing a certain kid-catching expedition that had come through Pine Ridge two decades before, he hadn’t been expecting to find a Heavy Runner mumbled in there.

facts.fact: 结尾房车停下：乘客门侧镜里照出沿路肩跑来的 Nate Yellow Tail——光着上身，摔倒一次又爬起，半边脸结着干涸血痂，张着嘴像孩子一样哭。
facts.anchor: Jogging up the shoulder, falling once but getting back up, shirtless, one side of his face crusted with dried blood, his mouth open like he was a child, crying, was Nate Yellow Tail.
